title: A script copy of a memstore row leaves the store unchanged
proves: row.to_dict() on a memstore row returns a copy: a nestedKey that adds a field to it changes neither the producer's output nor the memstore
a nested list field read from a memstore row holds copies of its rows
a nestedKey that reads the memstore as its source and adds a field changes neither the producer's output nor the memstore
a script that changes an iterated row, clears a list of rows or appends to a nested list leaf leaves the store unchanged
a later readback of the memstore sees the rows the producer wrote
